name: draft-review
description: The draft pass, and it is not a gate. It carries `draft_only: true`, so run_panel.py refuses it with exit 1 unless the run passes --draft: without the flag these same four seats would resolve onto the metered endpoint and bill for a pass whose whole definition is that it costs nothing. Run it with --draft: four lenses — the measured `spec-review` set — every one of them on a harness Claude subagent on the subscription, so the whole panel costs nothing beyond the owner's plan. One family by construction, which is why `min_families` is 1 and why the reconciliation opens by saying the run carries no corroboration claim: its findings are worth reading one by one and its agreement counts are one mind agreeing with itself under four lens prompts. Use it while a document is still being drafted and iterate on it as often as you like; promote the document on a multi-family panel, never on this. `requires_references: false`, so it also serves a seed document that has no source of truth to be judged against: on a draft run with no references the `fidelity` seat is retired rather than refused, because that lens cites on every finding, and the other three lenses judge the artifact on its own argument.
